data.content:
They sit rock-bottom of the league and are struggling to adapt to life with added European football.

Having lost five of their previous six league matches, it is hard to see the Black Cats picking up points against Chelsea.

Regis Le Bris' side will also be without Omar Alderete who is suspended, but Nordi Mukiele should return. [...] As for Chelsea, Moises Caicedo must be assessed after showing signs of “discomfort”, but Emi Martinez is “training well” and could return after the international break.

Having missed out on European football last season, the Blues have improved significantly under Xabi Alonso.

Chelsea are fourth and on course to qualify for the Champions League, which would represent a successful first campaign for the Spaniard. [...] With Sunderland struggling, they will be confident of getting another positive result.
